assessment_objectives.objective: data requiring Continuous Data Protection (CDP) is identified and documented.
automated Continuous Data Protection (CDP) mechanisms capture data changes as they occur for the identified data.
the recovery window for which Continuous Data Protection (CDP) change history is retained is defined.
Continuous Data Protection (CDP) mechanisms enable recovery of the identified data to a specific point in time within the defined recovery window.
point-in-time recovery from Continuous Data Protection (CDP) is tested at a defined frequency and the results are documented.
Continuous Data Protection (CDP) operation is monitored and capture failures or gaps generate alerts that are investigated and resolved.
